e: The story of me finding my love
s:
how i find my love. the story of me finding my love godot personal narrative unity godot setup 
in the beginning, god said, 'let there be unity,' and that is how the unity engine was born.

as you know, adobe and unity have a 98% dna match, so for everything i had to go to dr. google. google told me to go to brackeys, and that is how i found my messiah. he saved me from every problem. then came the shocking part.

![my messiah's holy face.](/images/blog/godot-setup/my_messiah.jpg "**my messiah's holy face. isn't that holy?**"){px}

my messiah was gone from youtube for four years. but one day, suddenly, my messiah returned and said,
>the old testament is abolished (old testament = unity). here is the new testament.
i was shocked why, why did you leave the old testament behind? my brain couldn't comprehend the reasoning, but i had faith in my messiah, so i followed in his footsteps.

he showed me the light. i was in darkness, but to me, that was my world; i never thought there was a world this beautiful, beyond imagination.

and that is how i found godot.
